name: R. G. Head
role: Prairie Cattle Co. manager; president of the International Range Association
bio: R. G. Head, general manager of the Prairie Cattle Co., drew notice in May 1885 for a circular urging his cowboys to be gentlemen whatever their dress. By December 1886 he signed as president of the International Range Association.
